findings.source_passage: the ripple lapping softly on the stones, the sun still low and only touching the hilltops
findings.why_it_matters: The clause 'the ripple lapping softly on the stones' is part of a sonorous, rhythmically distinctive landscape sentence; its omission breaks the triadic cadence ('cove all grey…ripple lapping…sun still low') that gives the opening its pictorial signature.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'the ripple lapping softly on the stones' between 'hoar-frost' and 'the sun still low' to preserve the original tricolon.

findings.source_passage: he cleared the hilt of his cutlass and loosened the blade in the sheath; and all the time we were waiting there he kept swallowing as if he felt what we used to call a lump in the throat
findings.source_locator: paragraph after 'So saying, the stranger backed along with me'
findings.why_it_matters: The specific action of loosening the blade and the narratorial aside 'what we used to call a lump in the throat' are interpretively and stylistically distinctive; the draft reduces this to 'he cleared the hilt of his cutlass and kept swallowing,' losing both the detail of readied violence and Jim's characterising voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'loosened the blade in the sheath' and 'as if he felt what we used to call a lump in the throat' to preserve the tonal precision of the original.

findings.source_passage: "Dear, deary me," cried my mother, "what a disgrace upon the house! And your poor father sick!"
findings.source_locator: near end, after the captain falls
findings.why_it_matters: Mrs. Hawkins's exclamation is a small but character-establishing moment of comic domestic priorities amid crisis; its absence flattens her voice and removes a touch of Stevensonian ironic humour.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert Mrs. Hawkins's line 'Dear, deary me—what a disgrace upon the house! And your poor father sick!' as the captain is found on the floor.

summary: The draft is largely faithful with no high-severity signature losses; two medium findings (an omitted clause in the iconic January-morning sentence and the flattening of Black Dog's frightened gesture) and one low finding (Mrs. Hawkins's comic exclamation) do not collectively reach the regeneration threshold.
